name: reading-motion
title: Reading motion
description: Scroll-driven cursor selection and paragraph placement with controlled playback, rich text and reduced-motion support.

files.content: "use client" import { useReadingMotion } from "./use-reading-motion" import { createHighlightPainter } from "./painters" import { ReadingCursor } from "./cursor" import type { CursorHighlightProps } from "./types" import styles from "./reading-motion.module.css" import { cn } from "./utils" export function CursorHighlight({ children, className, color = "blue", trigger, active, playKey, duration, delay, once, showCursor = true, scrollRoot, autoScroll, onComplete, onProgress, ref, ...props }: CursorHighlightProps) { const root = useReadingMotion({ trigger, active, playKey, duration, delay, once, scrollRoot, autoScroll, onComplete, onProgress, ref }, createHighlightPainter) return ( {children} ) }

export { CursorHighlight } from "./cursor-highlight"
export { MotionParagraph } from "./motion-paragraph"
export type { CursorHighlightProps, MotionParagraphProps, ReadingMotionHandle, ReadingMotionOptions } from "./types"

docs: Requires React 19 and CSS Modules. Import CursorHighlight / MotionParagraph from your components/reading-motion folder. Docs: https://clone-website-lab.2212148739lbw.workers.dev/components/reading-motion (接入代码).
